title: natural-transformation
description: A morphism between two parallel functors F, G : C → D — a family of components α_c : F(c) → G(c) satisfying the naturality square G(f) ∘ α_c = α_{c'} ∘ F(f) for every f : c → c'. The choice-free comparison of functors; the morphisms of the functor category [C, D].

source.description: the functor F it transforms from

target.description: the functor G it transforms to

components.description: for each object c, a morphism α_c : F(c) → G(c)

naturality.description: G(f) ∘ α_c = α_{c'} ∘ F(f) for every morphism f : c → c'
